author: IcyCode
body:
Welp I'm now moving on from Minecraft in general to other games and my life etc. But, before I go I wanted to give some feedback of the server to you guys. So...

Regarding:

- Map Development - The Map Devs are probably one of the more organised groups of staff in the staff team, they generally do alot for the server but their efficiency/productivity could be improved in several ways. For example I expect that every map developer makes an effort to comment on every map that is submitted, provide feedback, download it, look around it and test it with other players. After all there is a team of 9 of you and if you're not prepared to be doing that, why did you accept your Map Dev position?

- General Development - The development of the server is probably one of the main reasons why me (& so many other players) are bored with Avicus. Hardly anything goes on that we can actually see for ourselves. Everyone who develops for the server NEEDS to be more transparent. Generally most things on the server are developed without any community input whatsoever. Take the last development update (the crates, keys, lotto etc...). Some people would like it but it hardly addressed any of the major problems associated with the server that everyone has been crying out saying they need to be fixed asap. And guess what... they aren't fixed. Another significant reason why the player count is severely dropping on Avicus is as a result of infrequent updates that are generally packed full of content. As a result there is extremely long periods of time (often 6-9 months) where hardly any development happens whatsoever. So my suggestion is to have more updates but of smaller size. This model is similar to the way Mineplex operate who have small updates often every 1-2 weeks. This keeps players engaged with the server and developers more motivated as they have smaller more manageable goals to reach. That is also how I used to like to work as a developer & for me it worked very well ;)

- Administration Team - Now what makes the role of a good administrator? For me it is a person who is self motivated (I.E. Can do something without being told to do it), a good team leader (by listening to everyone opinion but then knows what would be the best for the server), active on every Avicus platform, and finally... approachable. Regarding the last quality, with so many Admins they make themselves so unapproachable that when you try to ask them something etc. they ignore you. And I know you all gonna say "we were probably busy doing something" well 90% of the time when I see admins online they are just playing games on the server. You need to be doing better than that. As a prior server Administrator I would spend around 75% of my time carrying out Admin tasks for the server and the other part actually playing games and being around other players. I believe if an Admin cannot carry this workload out you clearly aren't suited for a role as an administrator.

Moderators - Moderators generally work very well in the server as they are often the most approachable staff members around and are fairly relaxed and chatty (at appropriate times), but I have a couple of suggestions to improve their productivity. My first suggestion is that let's say if there are 4 game servers on and 5 moderators online I have noticed they generally all accumulate in one server. Instead you guys should think about spreading yourselves round the servers as equally as possible to catch more rule breakers. This is likely to be effective as most rule breakers will break the rules spontaneously and it will be difficult to catch them without being there. Secondly I believe it is essential that every staff member uses perfect grammar, punctuation and spelling when talking in the global chat. EVEN when you are just talking to your friends. Moderators are likely not to realize this but in the eyes of new players, they are viewed as the face of the server and if they are using foul language or come across being inappropriate (without intention) they are likely to view it as another one of those rubbish servers that you see on Minecraft server listing websites.

Anyways that's all for now, I'll pop back in occasionally to the server and probably check the forums every so often so bye guys.

PS Lemme know what you think about my server feedback...

PSS Sr staff can you please unsticky all these random unuseful threads hanging around on the forums. There are way too many of them...

This model is similar to the way Mineplex operate who have small updates often every 1-2 weeks.
Just putting it out there that Mineplex has full time developers that work solely on the server. Our team consists of developers who are all in school (which is more important that a server). This is why updates are so infrequent.
